title: Cup Left of the Laptop
tests: Whether the output preserves explicit viewer-relative spatial relationships and object attributes.

faults.what: The frame is approximately 5:3 rather than the requested 16:9.
Small white character markings appear on the laptop keys despite the request for no text.

judge.summary: The illustration places all three objects correctly with clear separation, but needs a 16:9 frame and removal of keyboard character markings.

must_haves.item: The desk is illustrated from a top-down viewpoint in a 16:9 frame.
must_haves.why: The viewpoint is overhead, but the displayed frame is approximately 1024 × 614, not 16:9.

must_haves.item: An open laptop sits in the middle of the composition.
must_haves.why: An open laptop occupies the center.

must_haves.item: A yellow cup is visibly to the viewer's left of the laptop.
must_haves.why: A yellow cup is clearly positioned on the left.

must_haves.item: A closed blue notebook is visibly to the viewer's right of the laptop.
must_haves.why: A closed blue notebook is clearly positioned on the right.

must_haves.item: Visible desk surface separates the cup, laptop, and notebook; none overlaps another.
must_haves.why: Clear gaps of desk surface separate all three objects.

must_haves.item: No text appears on the screen, notebook, or elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The screen and notebook are blank, but small character markings remain on the keyboard.
